Please look forward to new content and updated systems!
We sincerely thank all of you for playing Undershelter without forgetting.
Happy New Year!

notes.title: 0.1.4 Patch available now
notes.content:
Hey everyone, the update of Under Shelter has progressed!
There are newly added systems and updated contents.
The following is the change.

System change
-The distribution system has been renewed.
-The exploration reporting system has been added.
-The starting balance of the game has been corrected.
-The game's tutorial has been added.
-Added pop-up alarm system.
-Tooltips appear in the exploration menu.

Resource change
-The UI design of the distribution system has been renewed.
-The UI design of the exploration system has been renewed.
-The image of the lobby has been updated.
-Added pop-up alarm image.
-The main screen has been updated.

Bug fix
-If a survivor is sent on an expedition, the next day the survivors depart for an expedition, the health and mental are immediately reduced.
-Fixed a bug where the facility was not repaired.
-It has been modified so that survivors deployed in other facilities cannot be displaced or disassembled.
-Event duplication bug and resource increase/decrease error bug have been fixed.
-A bug in which the deceased survivor remains in the quest has been fixed.

Additionally, updates will continue.
Thank you for playing!
